After reading I thought to myself something among the lines of "Aww, poor guy who needs my help and will give me something in exchange? I would totally help him… wait, why is that tagged creepypasta?"

Few minutes on wikipedia taught me that I really, really shouldn't be easily putting my trust in random sentient objects.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
One thing that bothers me is the use of 'Allah'. If this was meant to be originally written in Arabic and translated into English, 'Allah' should have been translated into 'God'. If meant to be originally written in English, 'God' would have been written instead of 'Allah'. It's the arabic word for God, not an Islam-specific name. Arabic-speaking Christians call God, Allah.

Otherwise I like it. I like the idea that someone would free him before researching what they hold.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Plus, evolution will be your downfall. Specifically, you'll get to see humanity evolve into something… else, while you're left behind like an Austrelopithicus in the modern day.

Also, ageless immortality doesn't say anything about invulnerability. Get trapped in a rockfall, every bone in your body broken, agony beyond measure, and know that you can't die. And even IF we add invulnerability, you're still trapped in that rockfall. So instead of unending pain, now you get unending boredom and sensory deprivation. If/when you're eventually freed, you're insane.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Not to mention that eventually you will see and do everything, you will have read every book, seen every movie, played every game, and soon enough you won't even care for human company because you won't be able to bond with anyone in a meaningful way.
